SHB-76.title: High Yield Hybrid Millet
SHB-76.content: Excellent germination and strong early vigor. This hybrid millet delivered a high yield with uniform grain quality. The science-backed genetics clearly reflect in crop consistency and nutritional richness.

SHB-76.title: Consistent and Nutritious
SHB-76.content: The crop stand was uniform and healthy throughout the season. Yield performance was impressive, and the grains were rich and well-formed. A reliable hybrid millet variety.

SHM-4560.title: Excellent Oil Recovery
SHM-4560.content: The crop matured within 120 days and produced long pods filled with bold, shiny grains. Oil recovery was close to 42%, and the yield reached around 13 quintals per acre. Very satisfied with the results.

SHM-4560.title: Strong Mustard Performance
SHM-4560.content: Uniform flowering and well-filled pods across the field. The grains were fat and attractive. Yield performance was within the 12-14 quintals per acre range as mentioned.

SSW-407.title: Excellent 30+ Quintal Yield
SSW-407.content: Very high germination percentage with strong tillering. The crop matured in about 115 days and yielded nearly 34 quintals per acre. Thick and shiny 7-inch ears made harvesting very satisfying.

SSW-407.title: Uniform and Market Attractive
SSW-407.content: The ears were 6-8 inches long and grains were attractive and well-filled. Production was within the 30-35 quintals per acre range as described. A dependable wheat seed for commercial cultivation.
